I've called this review meeting because my standard process requires white-collar, finance, and employment counsel to each give a final recommendation on every open response item before I can record definitive decisions. So let's walk through where we stand. The current response packet describes the matter as an inquiry into distributor commissions, but it does not yet specify a voluntary disclosure position, a repayment amount, or an executive-interview protocol. I need each of you to weigh in with your recommendations on those items today so I can record yes-or-no decisions and implementation commitments before we leave this room. Let's start with white-collar counsel — what is your recommendation on whether we should make a voluntary disclosure?
